test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

ALLOW
solution: The correct answer is '**Permit**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Allow**' is '**Permit**'. • **Allow**: to give permission for somebody/something to do something or for something to happen. कुछ करने की अनुमति देना, कुछ होने देना • *Example: Photography is not **allowed** inside the temple.* • **Permit**: to allow somebody to do something or to allow something to happen. किसी बात की अनुमति देना या कोई बात होने देना • *Example: You are not **permitted** to smoke in the hospital.* **​Correct Answer:__** *Permit.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Reject**: to refuse to accept somebody/something. व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को अस्‍वीकार करना (मानने से इनकार करना) • **Stop**: to finish moving or make something finish moving रुकना या (किसी को) रोकना (गतिमान न रहना या न रहने देना) • **Disallow**: to not allow or accept something. न मानना या स्‍वीकार करना, स्‍वीकृति न देना 3b:T549, The correct answer is** 'Select only the best from choices'.**
